name: Fiana Astraea
original_name: フィアナ・アストレイア
source:
Affiliation: Saint April Academy 3rd year, Group A
Favorite food: Melon Shortcake
Gift: Dead Copy (can copy any kinds of Gifts as long as the user knows how the Gift works)

Fiana is the leader-in-waiting for the Saintess’ Knightage. A proud knight who fell in love with Kyushiro at first sight. As a knight, she's skilled with the sword and she wields the Sacred Sword ‘Astraea’.
